idea-plugin.name: Deepseek-Sync
idea-plugin.description:
Bring DeepSeek Web Chat into your IDE.
No more switching between browser and editor — just open the side panel, log in, and start chatting.
Highlights:
  • Embedded DeepSeek Web Chat in a side tool window
  • One-click access without leaving the IDE
  • Stay in flow and get answers faster
  • Support DeepSeek Platform in the IDE side panel
  • Custom URL browser with navigation and bookmarks

中文介绍：
  • 将 DeepSeek 网页版带入你的 IDE
  • 无需切换浏览器，侧边栏直接对话
  • 保持编码心流，更快获得帮助
  • 支持查看 DeepSeek Platform 数据
  • 自定义网址浏览器 + 导航 & 收藏夹
idea-plugin.change-notes:
